notes.title: Reaching the finish line! Full Release on Friday 27th of August 2021
notes.content:
Hello Friends and Drifters,

after almost one year of Early Access polishing, tweaking and feature adding, the time has finally come!
On the 27th of August 2021, 17:00 CET, Star Drift Evolution will become fully released with the 1.0 Update.

This also means that a new season starts, with fresh leaderboards to compete on!

Here is a short recap of what has been improved and added during Early Access:
[list]
[*] [b]team racing[/b] for online multiplayer and new fun modes like moon gravity or no brakes
[*] added [b]Daily Challenges[/b] with weekly Leaderboards
[*] added [b]15 new Tracks[/b] and polished existing ones with greater detail
[*] added over [b]10 new cars[/b] including fun cars like go-karts and monster trucks
[*] new career chapters and [b]special events[/b] like truck races
[*] [b]improved AI[/b] driving lines and options to make the AI easier or harder
[*] overhauled [b]UI[/b] with new design
[*] added [b]horns and customizable emojis[/b]
[*] added [b]hood view[/b] camera
[*] [b]discord notifications[/b] for whenever the top 10 of a leaderboard change
[*] added [b]new music[/b]
[*] added [b]news ticker[/b] to the main menu
[*] improved [b]camera customization[/b]
[/list]

We hope that the Early Access period has helped making the game a better experience, and that we will see you on the track very soon!

Cheers,
SDE Team

notes.title: Beta for the 1.0.0 Update
notes.content:
The [b]beta [/b]for the 1.0.0 update is now [b]live[/b]! This update will advance Star Drift Evolution from early access to full release!

If you already have the game, you can join the Beta by right clicking Star Drift Evolution in your Steam library and going to Properties->Betas->openbeta. We encourage everyone to take a look and provide us with feedback to make the update the best it can be!


A lot has been worked on and you can check out the full changelog in our discord channel here: https://discord.gg/gZqM6c9

A few highlights from the update:
- you can now [b]unlock stars in local multiplayer[/b], meaning you can complete the whole game together with your friends in splitscreen mode
- added [b]more details to all tracks[/b], like spectators, ad banners, scenery and improved lighting to make them feel more alive and beautiful
- [b]new tracks and cars[/b]: 75 tracks and 50 cars in total now
- [b]new achievements[/b], including fun challenges like racing with monster trucks, oldschool vans or school buses
- [b]improved UI[/b]
- overhauled and [b]improved all engine sounds[/b]
- [b]improved netcode[/b] for better multiplayer synchronization


See you on the track!
Cheers, Catze

notes.title: The 0.3.5 Update for Star Drift Evolution is live! TEAMS now available!
notes.content:
Hi everybody!
Star Drift Evolution continues to evolve! 

The biggest addition in this round of updates is the addition of a Teams mode for online multiplayer! 
This mode will give much more relevance to new players' results: even getting next to last might give your Team that final point needed to snatch the win!

[b]TL;DR Summary of the recent changelogs:[/b]

- Teams mode for online Multiplayer
- New liveries and full livery customization on all slots
- AI / Times to beat finetuning
- Various QoL / UI improvements

Update 0.3.1 - 17-11-2020

Multiplayer:
- added team racing for multiplayer (beta)
- testing more accurate car positions when collisions are enabled (at the cost of less buffering)

Physics:
- slightly increased reverse speed, "R" gear is now shown in the UI

Cars:
- added 2 new livery patterns
- fixed the hood camera for godspeed

AI:
- AI improved on woods of yakutia

Graphics:
- shadow distance increased on high and very high graphics quality settings

Audio:
- sound for light collisions with rock/concrete improved

Fixes:
- when watching replays, wheels should no move to their default rest position during jumps, and front wheels should be aligned with the car's tilting
- fixed reverse engine sound


Update 0.3.2 - 17-11-2020

- fixed team racing assignment

Update 0.3.3 - 20-11-2020

Multiplayer:
- team racing team assignment improved
- improved netcode to sync the race start more accurately and reduced stuttering when observing remote players with high delay
- when a player disconnects in a team race, his score should no longer be removed from the team's total score
- smoothed the camera at the end of a race when observing other cars and switching targets

Fixes:
- fixed the cactus material on grand canyon being of type metal

Update 0.3.4 - 23-11-2020

Tracks:
- AI driving line improved on #5 and #10
- tree and cactus crash sound fixed on track #6 and #13
- ilha grande expert time adjusted (34 to 32 secs)

Cars:
- you can now customize all car color slots

Multiplayer:
- added a short blinking message when its YOUR turn to pick a track
- remote car wheels now rotate correctly

Options:
- removed the "mp delay" option as it has no effect on current netcode (dynamically adapts)

Replays:
- ghost replay cars now fade out when very close to the player (while ghost car transparency in the options is set < 100%)

UI:
- the menu world globe is now colored similar to the world map

Sound:
- new song from Electroshark
- new "star unlock" sound
- songs will no longer stop when leaving a race and will instead play their full duration

Hotfix:
- fixed customized car colors 1-3 not loading when restarting the game

Update 0.3.5 - 26-11-2020

Options:
- you can now customize which emoji is mapped to which rightstick direction/numpad key in the settings menu (you can now choose from a list of 65 emojis!)

Music/Sound:
- added a new song thats played while in the multiplayer lobby (https://soundcloud.com/grandpa-theobald/vaporsurge/s-YIhpMBfXmlC)
- new emoji popup sound
- added a horn sound to numpad 9 / right analog stick press (you might have to assign your right stick press to "horn" under "customize hotkeys")

Multiplayer:
- "your turn" notification now stays slightly longer
- "end of race" camera changed to offer the same camera controls as you have in "view replay" mode (use left/right to change cars)
- remote cars are now rendered opaque after the local player reached the finish
- tournament results should now be written to "C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\eu_Catze\Star Drift Evolution\last_tournament.txt"
- starting grid positions should now be more centered in multiplayer

notes.title: The 0.3.0 Update for Star Drift Evolution is live!
notes.content:
Hi everybody!
The Star Drift Evolution development continues in full swing, with a lot of fixes and feature to satisfy the most pressing players' requests, such as Steam Cloud Saves!

It has been another great week for us, and the feedback from you guys and girls it has been amazing! Please find below the detailed list of changes, starting from the most recent. 

[b]TL;DR Summary of the recent changelogs:[/b]

- Added Steam Cloud Saves. You asked for it, you got it. No more moving saves around! YAY!
- New Vehicle: "Godspeed". An awesome van, great for easy multiplayer action! :D
- New liveries and improved existing ones!
- Increased money earned x Star to allow quicker access to new cars!
- Various AI improvements!
- Ongoing MP games are now shown in the lobby: this also lets you see how many races were completed in active games. Very useful to know in how much time that group will open a new MP lobby! 
- New Campaign map look!
- Many more tweaks and fixes (e.g. - you can now reset your car while the chat window is open)


But now, onto the detailed changelogs (most recent first)

[b]Update 0.3.0 - 15-11-2020[/b]

Main New Feature:
- added Steam Cloud Saves (game progress will be synced, game settings NOT), let me know if you encounter any issues

Physics:
- reverse speed increased

Fixes:
- fog and lighting now affects grafiti on track #18
- in draft mode in multiplayer, cars should now be colored correctly more quickly
- fixed a bug with the chassis tilt animation

[b]Update 0.2.12 - 13-11-2020[/b]

General:
- worked on the campaign map look
- added a tip to the end of the tutorial, explaining the "quick restart" button

Multiplayer:
- you can now reset your car while the chat window is open when triggering the reset through your gamepad

AI:
- AI improved on track #43

Fixes:
- fixed a bug causing the "win 25 online tournaments" achievement to not work properly
- "player disconnected" messages should no longer pile up after a host closes a game
- "next ghost enemy" messages should no longer appear when racing the AI (where no ghosts are being shown)
- fixed the starting grid positions for winter village in multiplayer
- the intro song should now instantly start after the game finished loading

[b]Update 0.2.11 - 11-11-2020[/b]

General:
- very hard crashes with a force bigger than 2000 (occuring at roughly when crashing into a wall frontally at > 150 kmh) will now be more penalized to prevent luck-based "crash cornering" from being effective

Multiplayer:
- added information about how many races are completed in a lobby

AI:
- AI improved on tracks: #15, #32

Tracks:
- repositioned a few safety tyres in city circuit

Fixes:
- fix a bug in multiplayer causing a car to sometimes not spawn in "random track selection" mode

[b]Update 0.2.10 - 10-11-2020[/b]

AI:
- AI improved on tracks: #12, #16, #20, #25, #26, #27, #38

[b]Update 0.2.9 - 09-11-2020[/b]

Fixes:
- fixed a bug causing point to point tracks to sometimes not contribute to your skill rating
- fixed a bug causing the camera to follow other drivers after finishing a multiplayer race to stay on a car that has already finished
- lap count factor should no longer have an effect on point to point tracks in online multiplayer

[b]Update 0.2.8 - 08-11-2020[/b]

Multiplayer:
- should be very smooth now (fixed an issue when updating the car's position), if you set the buffer delay under "misc options" to about 200ms that should yield good results
- the race results panel now also displays the best lap time for each player, display duration slightly increased

Fixes:
- disabled exclusive fullscreen mode as it may cause issues on some system, you can instead enable it by adding "window-mode=exclusive" without quotation marks to your steam launch options (right click the game in the steam library and click properties -> general -> set launch options)


[b]Update 0.2.7 - 07-11-2020 (Windows, MacOS)[/b]

General:
- increased $ per unlocked star from 5000$ to 7500$, so that you can buy all cars at around 250 stars unlocked

Fixes:
- suspensions display fixed for godspeed car
- fixed online multiplayer scoreboard and race results


[b]Update 0.2.6 - 07-11-2020[/b]

Cars:
- new fun vehicle: "godspeed"
- added 8 new decal patterns
- you can now customize all vehicles (including fun vehicles like firefighter and soap spinner)
- improved how liveries are projected onto several car models

Graphics:
- enabled "exclusive fullscreen" mode for windows, together with "vsync on" (under graphics settings) this should result in a very smooth framerate, "vsync on" is now the default mode when starting the game for the first time

Multiplayer:
- stabilized netcode, cars should no longer clip through the ground or bounce up/down during multiplayer (during laggy conditions)
- improved car position accuracy when resetting the car
- buffer delay increased with collisions "on" for smoother and more predictable movement
- "random track" should now work properly after the first race finished
- "force different car colors" is now the default settings upon first launching the game
- the "player disconnected" message will now display the name of the player that disconnected instead of the players remaining in the lobby
- fixed an issue causing the camera to follow other cars after finishing to focus on the wrong car (will now focus on the best not yet finished car)

Tracks:
- fixed a visual water glitch on san andres
- hagfors section times adjusted slightly
AI:
- further improved AI liveries

UI:
- racing UI should now "stick" to their corresponding corner, regardless of resolution
- "news ticker" shouldnt disappear after doing online multiplayer, scroll speed increased, alternating white/yellow texts
- renamed "community" button to "discord"

Fixes:
- draft modes should now work properly after a player disconnected
- in point to point races, the "endless laps" option is now hidden
- fixed some flickering textures in one tutorial lesson
- fixed a bug causing a false "new improved position in the leaderboard" message to appear during online multiplayer
- fixed an issue with the score rankings when more than 1 player did not finish in multiplayer

- "news ticker" shouldnt disappear after doing online multiplayer, scroll speed increased, alternating white/yellow texts

- in point to point races, the "endless laps" option is now hidden

notes.title: The 0.2.5 Update for Star Drift Evolution is live!
notes.content:
Hi everybody!
The player feedback on Star Drift Evolution has been great so far, and we've been listening to your suggestions!

We think it's the right time to let you know what we've been working on in this first week. Please find below the detailed list of changes, starting from the most recent. 

[b]TL;DR Summary of the recent changelogs:[/b]

- Addition of a ticker in the Main Menu to show incoming game events / tips. 
- Addition of a broadcast message that lets all online player know that a new Multiplayer game has been hosted
- Engine sounds improved
- UI scaling option
- Constant balancing of AI and Lap Times to beat
- Constant bugfixing

But now, onto the detailed changelogs (most recent first)

[b]Update 0.2.5 - 05-11-2020[/b]

UI:
- added a scrolling news and tips feed to the main menu
- added an option to scale the UI (should be useful for super widescreen resolutions, cropping the UI sometimes)
- added a tip message explaining the "quick restart" hotkey when crashing for the first time in a session and having less than 25 stars in total

AI:
- ramming the AI will push them away a bit more than before

Multiplayer:
- added new "random track selection" option
- exposed the "remote car delay" setting in the options menu (increased delay = smoother movement when lag spikes occur, decreased delay = more accurate positions)
- after a race has finished, the NEXT track is selected by default instead of the same one (so in case of confirming a track accidentally you will not play the same track twice)
- players leaving and then re-entering a lobby should now have their car positioned properly
- "picked same", "recommended same" and "pick from pool" modes now automatically activate "force different colors", because otherwise all/several players would end up with the same car model in white color
- "force different colors" should now work properly in all modes, let me know if you still encounter issues
- added an "end race" timer of 2.5 minutes when the first player finishes
- disabled track voting in multiplayer

Tracks:
- adjusted 2 checkpoints on canyonfall to not put you on a slope that will push you into the water
- fixed floating rocks in south africa farm
- improved AI line on shanghai docks
- egypt finish line height fixed
- varnek water distance fog now matches skybox
- everlong forest expert lap time increased to 3:05
Music:
- added new song 'turbocharger' by electroshark (if you like his songs, you can check out more of them here: electroshark.bandcamp.com)

Audio:
- did a pass on engine sounds (shorty, petite, thunderbolt, stylo, turbo, champion, super, rocket, falcon, el toro, nitro)
- added a new option slider to adjust the car engine volume

Graphics:
- added 144 fps framecap setting

Cars:
- did a pass on default car liveries and AI liveries
- car headlight range increased (to give a more frontal light cone)

Fixes:
- fixed a bug causing the "ghost livery solid color" option to override liveries permanently
- when in 3rd person, emojis triggered by other players should now also appear smaller to block vision less
- fixed the "jump time" achievements

[b]Update 0.2.4 - 01-11-2020[/b]

Tracks:
- expert time on temple raceway adjusted

UI:
- added a new option (under misc) to disable liveries and just use solid colors for ghost replays (this way a ghost replay will always look different than you car if you use a livery)
- added a 30 fps cap option
- if you enter the car market from the campaign map, you will be brought back to it when leaving the car market
- the chat window will no longer close after the "idle" timer runs out while in lobby
- stars unlocked and skill rating are now hidden in the main menu settings
- credits updated

Multiplayer:
- "picked same" is now the default multiplayer car selection mode

AI:
- AI weakened slightly on tracks: #1 #2 #3
- difference between the best and the weakest AI driver as been increased (best driver unchanged)
- AI line improved on rainfall raceway and sandpit
- AI cars are now fixed for a given track
- red rammers AI no longer appears in the first 2 cups

Fixes:
- car selection camera angle fixed on tracks: 10, 27, 28, 35, 45, 47, 51, 53, 54, 55, 59
- fixed orange stars (from unlock animation) sometimes showing on wrong tracks when unlocking new stars in the campaign and changing tracks afterwards
- fixed the demo text overlapping with the stars unlocked text


[b]Update 0.2.3 - 31-10-2020[/b]

Fixes:
- hotfix for records and replays not uploading to the steam leaderboard when doing endless time trial mode and lap count > normal race lap count

[b]Update 0.2.2 - 31-10-2020[/b]

General:
- added the "new multiplayer game hosted" broadcast message, for when a player opens am online lobby

Tracks:
- expert time adjusted on #30 (grand canyon)

Fixes:
- fixed a bug with unlocked stars sometimes displaying incorrectly in the track menu
- cars should no longer spawn inside the ground on track #59
